HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.
   B. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Social festivals? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Social festivals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Social festivals.
   C. Say Social festivals has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Social festivals to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Bhagwat Gita? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bhagwat Gita to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Bhagwat Gita has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bhagwat Gita.
   D. Apply the teaching of Bhagwat Gita with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories has no place in daily life.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

7. Which response best shows understanding of Evening Prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Evening Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Evening Prayer.
   C. Use Evening Prayer to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Evening Prayer has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Self-awareness? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self-awareness.
   B. Use Self-awareness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Self-awareness has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   C. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Self-awareness and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Evening Prayer and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Bhagwat Gita and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Pranayam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Evening Prayer and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
